tools.description: Overview of Avineon, a geospatial company in the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium and France: what it does, its services, FME and Esri ArcGIS offerings, training, industries, accreditations and contact details. Use this first for general questions about the company.

tools.name: list_services

tools.name: get_page

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search all of Avineon's web pages (services, technology, industries, case studies, training, blog, events, about) with a keyword or natural-language query. Returns ranked pages with snippets. Falls back to English when the chosen language has no match.

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Find Avineon case studies (customer projects) by keyword, industry or technology, e.g. 'utility network', 'water', 'FME Flow Hosted', 'rail'. Without a query, lists all case studies.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, search_site, get_contact_info · Private data: get_company_overview, get_contact_info, find_transformers_for_task, estimate_arcgis_online_backup_cost, recommend_fme_licence, get_fme_licensing_overview, estimate_fme_flow_hosted_cost · Public sink: get_page, get_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, search_site, get_contact_info · Private data: get_company_overview, get_contact_info, find_transformers_for_task, estimate_arcgis_online_backup_cost, recommend_fme_licence, get_fme_licensing_overview, estimate_fme_flow_hosted_cost · Public sink: get_page, get_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
